Pro Feature
Cloud Sync

Work on two computers and keep the same orders, quotes, inventory and settings on both — with no monthly fee. Your data file lives in your own cloud folder (OneDrive, Dropbox or Google Drive) and your cloud app syncs it between machines.

How Sync Works
1
Set up sync once on each computer, pointing both at the same file in your cloud folder.
2
Use one computer at a time. Let your cloud app finish syncing before you switch.
3
When you open the tool, click Reconnect and allow access to load the latest.
Sync needs Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge on a desktop computer. On Safari, Firefox or phones, use Export in the bottom bar and Restore below to move your data by hand — that always works.
Backup & Restore

Export saves a full copy of your data to your downloads — your spare safety net, separate from sync. Restore loads one of those files back in. Restoring replaces your current data, so it asks first.

    Customer Records

    New here? This is everything you need to use this section well — what's inside, how matching works, and how to keep your data safe.

    What this tool does

    Keep every customer's logo, embroidery file, placement, stabilizer, thread colors, and notes in one place, and match logo colors to the thread brand you stock. Everything stays on this computer — nothing is uploaded anywhere.

    How to use it

    • 1In Customers, add a customer, then add a design — drop the logo and fill in placement, stabilizer, the embroidery file name, and any notes.
    • 2In Match colors, pick the brand you stock, then Auto-match this logo (or tap colors on the logo). Use swap on any row to pick a different thread.
    • 3Approve all & add to design, then Save to customer. It lands under that customer for the next order.

    Thread brands included

    match to one brand at a time

    In Match colors you pick the one brand you actually stock — matching only uses that brand. These are loaded and ready:

    Matches aren't exact — check your thread card

    Every match is a close visual suggestion, not a guarantee. Screen colors, the logo file, and thread sheen all change how a color reads, so always confirm against your physical thread card or cone before stitching.

    Each match shows a Match difference number — how far the thread is from your color (0 is exact, lower is closer):

    • Under 3 — Excellent. Effectively a match.
    • 3 to 6 — Close. A slight difference, fine for most jobs.
    • Over 6 — Check thread card. Noticeably off; verify before you stitch.

    Keeping your data safe

    Your customers and saved designs are part of Shop Suite Pro. They are saved in this browser and travel inside the same backup and sync as the rest of the app, so there is nothing separate to manage here.

    Use Export Backup in the bar at the bottom of the window to save one file with everything in it: customers, designs, quotes, orders, inventory, and settings. Turn on Cloud Sync from the Sync section to keep two computers in step. One backup now covers your whole shop.

    Customers & Saved Designs

    Backing Up

    Your data is stored on this computer. Clearing your browser data removes it. Turn on Cloud Sync (Chrome or Edge) to keep it across computers, and use Export Backup for a spare copy. You can restore a backup from the Cloud Sync page.

    iOS Safari may clear data if the file hasn't been opened in 7 days. Back up more often on mobile.
    Common Questions
    My revenue chart shows $0.
    Revenue only counts when an order is marked Complete. Open finished orders and move them to that status.
    I switched browsers and my data is gone.
    Data is stored in the browser you originally used. Open that browser to find it. Always use the same browser.
    Customer wants changes after converting to an order.
    Open the order, edit the lines directly, and use Export PDF on the order row to send a revised copy.
    PDF export does nothing.
    Try Chrome or Edge. Safari sometimes blocks local file downloads.
    Profit margin looks wrong.
    Margin only calculates when a Job Cost is entered on the order. Open the order and add your actual cost.
